submitted.rationale: Of the five compositions measured, index 18 (Sb fraction 0.735) had the highest EQE, 0.00638%. EQE fell off on both sides: 0.0023% at Sb 0.656, 0.0023% at 0.759 and 0.0031% at 0.806. The peak is sharp, a little on the Sb-rich side of CuSb2O6.

rejected.reason: Not measured. The trend falls toward lower Sb (0.0032% at 0.558), and CuO-rich films tend to be p-type or have a small band gap. This is an inference, not a measurement.
